set.body: PRD IO-1, IO-2, IO-2a, P-1. Streaming via fs2, constant memory. Recover samples, pupil, blink/saccade messages, recording start/stop, and experimenter messages with source lines. Stimulus messages land in ObservedTimeline on their source clock, never ocular Event or an untyped Recording side channel. Planned timestamps are not promoted to observed. Common triggers use shared SyncEvidence fitting and insufficient evidence is explicit.
